hypotheses.D1_per_context_rank64_is_locally_compact: A same-context rank-64 tangent PCA retains at least 75% local tangent energy for every target and boundary.
hypotheses.D2_per_context_rank64_is_causally_useful: The rank-64 dynamic chart preserves at least 75% final Fisher-response fidelity for every target-boundary pair.
hypotheses.D3_dynamic_chart_beats_static_vocabulary: Dynamic rank-64 Fisher fidelity exceeds static shared rank-64 fidelity by at least 0.20 for every target-boundary pair.
hypotheses.D4_per_context_rank128_is_causally_suffi: The rank-128 dynamic chart preserves at least 90% final Fisher-response fidelity for every target-boundary pair.
hypotheses.D5_context_charts_rotate: Mean pairwise leading-64 subspace overlap across held-out contexts is at most 0.50 for every target and boundary.
